name: Atrium Fountain
summary: Circular stone atrium fountain with two centre bowls and eight static water arcs.
description: Original brand-neutral 5 m circular stone basin with an eased coping, recessed plinth, two tiered centre bowls, bronze nozzle fittings, eight arcing translucent water jets and a separate shallow water disc. Water meshes are static and named for consumer animation.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / Codex-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python; no external models, images, textures, fonts or brands.

runtime_contract.WATER_Jets: Single mesh containing eight disconnected, capped parabolic tubes. Static geometry at rest; consumer owns any vertex/material animation. Node origin is the floor centre.
runtime_contract.WATER_Surface: Independent 6 mm shallow water disc within the basin. Static material/geometry; consumer owns animation. Node origin is the floor centre.
runtime_contract.WATER_BowlPools: Static shallow water discs in the two central bowls.

material_notes: Three shared texture-free materials: vertex-colour honed stone, satin bronze, and alpha BLEND aqua water. No transmission/refraction or exported lights. Five mesh primitives; transparent surfaces can require additional runtime passes.
accuracy_notes: Original illustrative water feature, not an engineering, installation or safety specification. The basin rim is 0.8 m high; the centre finial raises the complete envelope to 2.15 m. Static water shapes are not a fluid simulation. Alpha sorting is renderer dependent. Full-mall animation/performance, physical Android/iOS and WebKit are not verified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry, vertex colours and materials. No external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
